question: Unchecked Power deals 12 damage to all units at battlefields. Player 2 has Viktor - Leader and two Vanguard Sergeants at a battlefield. How many Recruits does Player 2 play when Unchecked Power resolves?
reframe: when Viktor is killed in the same cleanup as the units whose deaths he watches, does the current rule explicitly prevent his triggered ability from evaluating?

holding.line: Zero Recruits. All three units are killed in the same cleanup, and the October 9 rules explicitly prevent a trigger from evaluating when its source leaves its active zone simultaneously with the event it watches. The rules give this exact Viktor and Unchecked Power example.

spans.text: All three units are killed in the same cleanup
prevent a trigger from evaluating when its source leaves its active zone simultaneously

notes.claim: 12 damage is lethal to every unit involved: Viktor - Leader is 4 Might and each Vanguard Sergeant is 4 Might.
notes.detail: Unchecked Power reads "Exhaust all friendly units, then deal 12 to ALL units at battlefields." Viktor - Leader: 4 Energy / 4 Might / 1 Power, Unit, Order, "When another non-Recruit unit you control dies, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token into your base." Vanguard Sergeant: 4 Energy / 4 Might, Unit, Order, no printed ability, Tags Elite/Demacia — not a Recruit.

cites.quote: Lethal Damage is the amount of marked Damage that will cause a unit to die in a cleanup.

notes.claim: All units with lethal damage are killed together in one cleanup task, so the three deaths are simultaneous.

cites.quote: 3a. All Units that have Lethal Damage marked on them are killed and placed in their owners' Trash. See rule 142.4. For more information on lethal damage.

notes.claim: The exception for a trigger watching its own source leave the board does not apply to Viktor watching another unit die.

cites.quote: If a Game Object has a Triggered Ability whose condition is the Game Object leaving the board, such a Triggered Ability is processed immediately before the Game Object changes zones.

notes.claim: A permanent's triggered ability can only have its condition evaluated while the permanent is on the Board.

cites.quote: Triggered Abilities of Permanents are only able to have their Conditions evaluated while on the Board.

notes.claim: Viktor cannot evaluate the Sergeants' deaths when he leaves the board in the same game action; the official example expressly says his ability does not trigger in this Unchecked Power cleanup.
notes.if_false: If Viktor survived while both Sergeants died, his ability could evaluate each death and create two Recruits.

cites.quote: A Game Object will not be able to successfully evaluate its Trigger Condition, however, if it leaves the zone that its Trigger is active from at the same time that its Trigger is satisfied.

Viktor, Leader says “When another non-Recruit unit you control dies, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token into your base.” This ability triggers if Viktor is on the board immediately after another non-Recruit unit you control dies. It does not trigger if Viktor and another non-Recruit unit you control die during the same game action (for instance, if they are both killed in the same Cleanup due to the damage dealt by Unchecked Power).

counterargument.reading: The deaths are simultaneous, so Viktor might still see both Sergeants die before he is removed.
counterargument.why_it_loses: Current CR383.2.c.2 explicitly says a source cannot evaluate its trigger if it leaves its active zone at the same time the trigger condition is satisfied. Its published example names Viktor and Unchecked Power and says no trigger occurs. This is now directly covered rather than inferred from absence of another exception.

Viktor, Leader says “When another non-Recruit unit you control dies, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token into your base.” This ability triggers if Viktor is on the board immediately after another non-Recruit unit you control dies. considered_rejected.why: The restriction for Nth-time abilities is unnecessary here: the explicit simultaneous-departure rule already prevents Viktor from triggering.
This exception concerns a trigger whose own source leaves the board; Viktor watches another non-Recruit unit instead.

open_questions: If Viktor is not at a battlefield, Unchecked Power does not damage him. If he survives while both Sergeants die, his ability can evaluate normally and play two Recruits.
